steps.text: Scenario: A New Home: Crater for a first game; others are set up from the Scenario Book
Choose a Society card (I-VI) and Normal or Hard (first game: Society I - Normal); it sets the starting numbers below
Generator tile in the middle; 6 Rim pieces around it as a hexagon, cliff side up
Generator (with drawer) and the Cookhouse on the Generator tile; 5 Wood and 5 Coal on it
steps.note: Keep the Generator Upgrade boxed until needed

steps.text: Starting Wall tiles facedown; from any corner, clockwise, flip 1 per corner until 3 show Deposits; box the rest
Shuffle the Far and Near Map tiles separately; a Far tile in each corner without a Deposit, a Near tile between it and the Generator
Flip those tiles; put the Resources and Trees shown on them
steps.note: Food icons are added to the Food track later

steps.text: Bank: spare Wood, Coal, Steam Cores, Trees, Citizen meeples and Automatons (Crater uses no Steel)
Expedition cards for the scenario, split into A, B, C decks white side up; 3 A cards faceup on the right edge of the map
4 random Technology cards faceup on the bottom-right edge, each with an inactive Development token (Crater: no Steam Hub)
Population board above the map: Citizen and Sickness markers as on the Society card (Society I: 22 Workers, 12 Engineers, 8 Children)
Food marker on the Society card value (Society I: 8) plus any Map tile Food; Hunger marker on 0
Supply board right of the map: Corpse marker, starting Wood, Coal and Steam Cores, Citizen meeples and Automatons per the Society card
steps.note: Society I: Corpse on 1; 4 Wood, 5 Coal; 2 Child, 3 Engineer, 5 Worker meeples; 0 Automatons

steps.text: Spent Citizen tokens beside the Supply board
Buildings board below the Supply board; Buildings sorted onto it, non-upgraded side up
Hope & Discontent board left of the Population board; tokens into their bags; draw tokens as the Society card says (Society I: 2 Discontent, 1 active; 2 Hope, both active)
Round & Morning board above it: Round marker on 1; Morning deck shuffled; Storm marker per the scenario (Crater: space 9)
Law cards L01-L08 faceup; add 4 random of L09-L16; Consequence cards facedown beside them
Below the Buildings board: Child Shelter, the 4 Faith/Order Buildings and any Buildings the chosen Laws need
Dusk board above the Population board: Inevitable card (D000) facedown in the middle, Social Disputes faceup on the right
Read the top Social Dispute, flip it facedown and shuffle it with the Inevitable card: the Dusk deck
Generator board left of the map: Heat marker on space 1; Heat Range red, orange, yellow on spaces 1-3; Cold marker on space 5
Weather cards for the scenario (Crater: all) shuffled facedown on the Generator board
Each player chooses an Advisor card (assign at random if you disagree)
Solo: also take the Call to Rise card
Shuffle the scenario's Citizen cards (Crater: all) bottom left of the map; each player draws {n}
Each player discards 1 Citizen card faceup right of the deck and pays its starting cost
steps.note: If the cost can't be paid, discard any card and add 1 sick Citizen of its type instead

steps.text: Phase tracker card nearby, Phase marker on the Action Phase
Scenario cards in the Scenario display (Crater: I/01 faceup); Scenario Trigger tokens on the Round track (Crater: 4 and 11)
Storm card facedown left of the Weather deck (Crater: I/08); Stockpile markers near the Scenario display
Responsibility sheets: one per Advisor; share out the rest (solo: take all)
Round 1 skips phases 1-5: start with the Action Phase
Disagreements: the Leadership marker holder decides
Lose on: no Hope, a 6th Discontent, a second Generator breakdown, Sickness 26+, Hunger 25+, or a full Corpse track
Give the Leadership marker to a random player
